task: Review every supplied part, discover the most consequential events from the supplied evidence, cluster related reports, assign the best-fit broad news category dynamically and produce up to 150 processed stories using schema/processed-news.schema.json. The final portfolio must contain at least five well-supported stories in every category. Treat social attention as a discovery signal rather than verification. More than half of the final stories must originate with independent, local or social discovery, using the first source in each story as the discovery source; established outlets may account for no more than half.

items.title: Karnataka schools likely to stay open on Aug 13 as KAMS withdraws bandh closure call
items.summary: Schools across Karnataka are likely to remain open on Thursday, August 13, with the Karnataka Associated Managements of Schools (KAMS) withdrawing its earlier call for school closures. The KAMS had initially called for a closure of schools, as part of a bandh, over the ongoing Cauvery water dispute between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu. The KAMS said the decision was taken because another closure would further affect academic schedules, particularly in aided schools already facing a shortage of teachers. KAMS said it would nevertheless extend moral and peaceful support to the bandh called by Kannada organisations to protest Karnataka's release of Cauvery water to Tamil Nadu. School managements, teaching staff and non-teaching employees have been asked to wear black ribbons or black strips as a symbolic gesture, without disrupting classes. The association said academic activities had already been affected because teachers have been deputed for the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
